steps.why: The error indicates that ./dataset/weather.csv is missing. The dataset folder was downloaded via gdown but apparently did not include weather.csv. This command checks for the file and downloads it from a known reliable source (the Informer2020 repository) if absent, ensuring the subsequent import and run_all.sh can succeed.

steps.command: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends wget && if [ ! -f /work/dataset/weather.csv ]; then first_csv=$(ls /work/dataset/weather/*.csv 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$first_csv" ]; then cp "$first_csv" /work/dataset/weather.csv; echo "Copied $first_csv to /work/dataset/weather.csv"; else wget -q --show-progress -O /work/dataset/weather.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouhaoyi/Informer2020/master/dataset/weather.csv; echo "Downloaded weather.csv"; fi; else echo "weather.csv already present"; fi
